title: No Audio, No Transcripts, No Problem: LLM-based ASR Adaptation Using Only Domain Documents
abstract: arXiv:2611.27434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a speech recognizer be adapted to a new domain with no target audio and no transcripts, using only written documentation? This is the realistic onboarding setting: a new customer hands over raw documentation, not the transcripts that text-only adaptation normally assumes. We turn a domain's documents into adaptation text in two ways, directly as written sentences or rendered by a large language model (LLM) into synthetic spoken dialogs, and feed them to a recently proposed denoising-based text-only adaptation method. We show that, across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-domain settings on two corpora, document-only adaptation can match or closely approach real transcriptions; whether written or conversational rendering is best depends on speaking style and the amount of text generated. translated_title: 无音频、无转写文本，无妨：仅使用领域文档的基于LLM的ASR适配
translated_abstract: 能否在没有目标音频和转写文本的情况下，仅使用书面文档将语音识别器适配到新领域？这是现实的接入场景：新客户交付的是原始文档，而非纯文本适配通常所假设的转写文本。我们通过两种方式将领域文档转化为适配文本：直接作为书面句子，或由大语言模型（LLM）渲染成合成口语对话，并将其输入最近提出的一种基于去噪的纯文本适配方法。我们表明，在两个语料库上的域内、域外和跨域设置中，仅使用文档的适配可以达到或非常接近使用真实转写文本的效果；书面渲染还是对话式渲染更优取决于说话风格和生成的文本量。据我们所知，这是首个针对基于LLM的ASR进行仅文档适配的研究。由于目前没有现有语料库同时包含音频、转写文本和文档……
tldr: 该研究首次提出仅使用领域文档（无需目标音频和转写文本）对基于LLM的语音识别系统进行领域适配，通过将文档直接作为书面文本或由LLM渲染为合成口语对话，其适配效果可媲美甚至接近使用真实转写文本的结果。
en_tdlr: This is the first study of document-only adaptation of LLM-based ASR, showing that using domain documents—either directly as written sentences or rendered by LLMs into synthetic spoken dialogs—can match or closely approach adaptation with real transcriptions, without requiring any target audio or transcripts.
